title: Trump accuses big oil companies of ‘gouging’ consumers as gasoline prices fail to match falling crude costs, orders DOJ
summary: The directive comes as fuel prices remain elevated despite a sharp decline in global oil prices following an interim peace agreement between the United States and Iran.
